description: This file declares the RuntimeManagerImplementation class, which implements runtime management, configuration, and event handling for containerized applications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and external dependencies related to runtime control, container events, and system configuration.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements runtime management, configuration, and event handling for containerized applications, including methods for starting, stopping, and querying container states, as well as event callbacks for container lifecycle events.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A dispatchable job class used internally to handle runtime events asynchronously.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for runtime events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts a containerized application with specified parameters.

methods.name: Wake
methods.description: Wakes the specified application instance from a hibernated state.

methods.name: Kill
methods.description: Forcefully kills the specified application instance.

methods.name: GetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific application instance.

methods.name: Annotate
methods.description: Adds metadata to an application instance.

methods.name: Mount
methods.description: Mounts necessary resources for runtime operation.

methods.name: Unmount
methods.description: Unmounts resources used by the runtime.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the runtime manager with the provided service.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStartedEvent
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container starts.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStoppedEvent
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container stops.

methods.name: onOCIContainerFailureEvent
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container fails.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container's state changes.
